svg.text: What every other routine in the solver reads
Left: the error on one grain, zoomed in until the pattern shows. Band is every possible state, line is one particular state.
Right: the worst a grain of each size can suffer, which resets at every power of two and is why 100 um is not the 0.391 per cent headline.
